# Runecraft

1 method trains Runecraft, from wiki/world/methods.ts. Every XP/hr is the floor: the tick-perfect rate, not a forecast ([README](README.md) says what each column means). XP/hr is game XP, the server's XP rate (x25) included; gp/hr is the products kept at item value (obj `cost`); Supplies/hr is how many of each supply an hour uses, and their gp value.

Min is the level the whole method needs, every skill of it at that level together; a level column has Runecraft at that level and every other skill at it or at the method's own level of it, whichever is higher, with the best pickaxe usable there, and `-` under the method's Runecraft level. gp/hr, the binding term and Supplies/hr are at 99. Measured is a bot's XP/hr at the level its runs started at, and in brackets it over the floor there. Below the table, each method: what it requires, its sink, its supplies, and who measured it.
